title: ASCENT — The Cipher Worlds
subtitle: Adaptive Algebra I mastery, built to a Fortnite / Breath of the Wild bar
summary: Live and playable at robglnn.github.io/aadmath. Mobile clean in both orientations. A teacher can switch the progress record between TEKS and Common Core, and a department head passed it for adoption at 8/10. The cold-player gate — real key input, debug API forbidden — passes 6/6 against the production URL.
